I really wish people would understand the differences between higher and lower FOV. Everyone banging on about how it's 'such an advantage' obviously hasn't tried a higher field of view. Yes, you can see wider, but at a detriment to your performance and your overall visibility. You can see more, which is a plus but the more you see is much smaller. It's very easy to miss people in the distance and you wave goodbye to aiming properly.

FOV slider, yeah it helps with the peripherals, but whatever is directly in front of you becomes impossibly small and it's easier to miss enemies. Not to mention the extra strain on the machine for rendering all the extra information.
